dog.title: How I care for my pup
dog.mealsCount_one: Your pup gets {{count}} meal a day.
dog.mealsCount_other: Your pup gets {{count}} meals a day.
dog.mealsByParent: During quiet hours a parent feeds it: {{windows}}.
dog.water: When the bowl is almost empty (water at {{percent}} or less), give it fresh water. Wait at least {{gap}} between refills.
dog.walk: Today it needs {{steps}} steps of walking. Steps give it energy.
dog.takeOut: A puppy can hold it for about {{hours}}. Before that, press “Take out”.
dog.difference: “Take out” and a walk are not the same. Walking steps never take your pup to pee — for that, always press “Take out”.
dog.digestion: After a meal, wait {{minutes}} before you go for a walk.
dog.sleepNight: It sleeps from {{start}} to {{end}}. Don't wake it then: play, school, cuddles and brushing wait until morning.
dog.sleepSchool: It also sleeps while you're at school ({{start}}–{{end}}).
dog.sleepNone: No quiet hours are set, so your pup has no fixed sleep time.
dog.mess: If it makes a mess, clean it up within {{hours}}.

cat.title: How I care for my kitty
cat.mealsCount_one: Your kitty gets {{count}} meal a day.
cat.mealsCount_other: Your kitty gets {{count}} meals a day.
cat.mealsByParent: During quiet hours a parent feeds it: {{windows}}.
cat.water: When the bowl is almost empty (water at {{percent}} or less), give it fresh water. Wait at least {{gap}} between refills.
cat.play_one: Play with it with the feather wand {{count}} time a day.
cat.play_other: Play with it with the feather wand {{count}} times a day, at least {{gap}} apart.
cat.litter: Scoop the litter within {{hours}} after your kitty uses it, and change all of it every {{days}} days.
cat.scratching: If you skip a day of play, it may scratch the sofa. Then take it to the scratching post and praise it.
cat.sleepNight: It sleeps from {{start}} to {{end}}. Don't wake it then: play, cuddles and brushing wait until morning.
cat.sleepSchool: It also sleeps while you're at school ({{start}}–{{end}}).
cat.sleepNone: No quiet hours are set, so your kitty has no fixed sleep time.
cat.mess: If it makes a mess, clean it up within {{hours}}.
